President Bola Tinubu on Thursday met behind closed doors with the President of the Senate, Godswill Akpabio, at the Presidential Villa, Abuja. The meeting comes barely two days before the All Progressives Congress flags off its presidential campaign in Kaduna on October 24, 2026. Our correspondent spotted Akpabio’s official Mercedes sedan driving off the Villa forecourt at about 4:45pm. The meeting lasted about an hour. The purpose of the meeting and the issues discussed could not be ascertained at the time of filing this report. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The APC will formally launch its nationwide presidential campaign in Kaduna on Saturday, October 24, ahead of the presidential election on January 16, 2027. Akpabio warns parties against denying tickets to experienced lawmakers Paramilitary recruitment: Shortlisted candidates face mandatory drug tests JUST IN: Shettima presides over NEC meeting The party’s National Chairman, Nentawe Yilwatda, said on Tuesday, after briefing Tinubu, that preparations were complete. A list of the campaign council leadership released in August named Tinubu as chairman, with Vice President Kashim Shettima and Yilwatda as vice chairmen and a former Zamfara State governor, Senator Abdul’aziz Yari, as Director-General. It named Akpabio as Deputy Director-General (South). The council was inaugurated on October 14. While appointing four national commissioners and two resident electoral commissioners for the Independent National Electoral Commission last Friday, October 16, Tinubu asked the Senate to expedite the confirmation of new commissioners. A day earlier, the Presidency said it would transmit the National Policing Bill to the National Assembly by October 29.
